notes: Master → Analysis Reports: test reports (Sl No., Content, Observed Value in %, Protocol Adopted) with Add row, a note after the table, Duplicate and Delete. Each report is linked to Item + Colour + Form + Mesh from the Item List. Print or email it as a PDF on the letter head of the firm chosen (Parakh Marketing by default), with the same head as the invoice. Invoice email: tick 'Analysis report' to attach the report of the items in the invoice (ticked by itself for buyers with Test report compulsory = YES). Sample dispatch email: the report of the grades sent is attached (tick box). First report made from the sample: Diatomaceous Earth Light Yellow.
